customManagers.description: The Playwright stack pins the same container images as compose.yml, but as TypeScript constants that no built-in manager reads.

packageRules.description: A .terraform-version file holds a bare version string, so it cannot carry a digest pin. The terraform manager defaults pinDigests to false for the same reason; the terraform-version manager does not, and a failed digest lookup makes Renovate drop the version update silently.

OpenTelemetry 0.300.0 breaks the app on Vercel: the ESM build of @opentelemetry/instrumentation-http loads forwarded-parse through createRequire, thus the build does not include it (https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-js/issues/7229). Remove these rules when a release fixes the issue.
